$comment: Which rules from .agents/cg/principles.md bind which folder.
AUTHORED BY HAND. No check proves a scope is correct — the verifier only proves a rule ID exists.
A wrongly narrow scope means a folder silently stops being told about a rule it must obey.
Design principles (DP-*) are NOT inherited. They are topic-scoped and loaded at a fork,
not stamped into every contract. An unavoidable guide is just a rule.
Key   — folder path relative to the repository root.
depth — number of path segments in the key. Verified against the key.
kind  — 'module' (a workspace root: needs CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md pointers) or 'folder'.
contract — path to the CONTRACT.md that receives the generated inherited-rules block.
rules — the rule IDs that bind this folder.
Run `cg sync` after editing, then `cg verify`.
The example below is commented out by shape, not by syntax — replace 'folders' with your own.
